cohort: The study participants were 418 postpartum women who had undergone cesarean delivery in public health facilities in Gondar, Ethiopia.
finding: Two-thirds (66.5%) of postpartum mothers following cesarean delivery experienced a lower health-related quality of life, which was significantly associated with inadequate postnatal care, pregnancy complications, general anesthesia, perceived pain after discharge, and postpartum depression.
cross-section timing: Between April and June 2024, at an unspecified time point postpartum.
